_comment: Rubric parameters v0.1.4 (Workbook Appendix B as corrected by docs/CHANGELOG-rubric.md). Every number here is a starting point to be calibrated in Phase 0. The engine must read all thresholds from this file; nothing numeric is hard-coded.

peer_gap._comment: v0.1.2: ties with peers take half a rank (rank_worst = 1 + strictly more binding + ties/2), so a target tied with every peer sits in the middle and scores 0.

comovement._comment: v0.1.2: the sign test is scored from an exact one-sided binomial p-value on the agree count (H0: agreement by chance, p = 0.5), not from a fixed consistency cut. Predicted direction: +1 when p <= weak_p (capped at predicted_sign_cap, the Workbook 4.7 asymmetry); wrong direction: -1 when p <= weak_p, -2 when p <= strong_p; else 0. Replaces comovement.graded of v0.1.1.

tiers._comment: v0.1.2: price_test_quantity_rule = ab_only (class C/D price families never vote; with no class A/B price family T_price is null, 'price not observed'); evidence_count_rule = voting_families (E, E_below, E_min, AB_count and load_bearing count voting families only; informing families are listed separately); test_weight_floor shrinks a test with thin weight mass toward zero (T_k = sum(w s) / max(sum(w), floor)); extreme_tier_informing_dissent_min_abs blocks ruled_out and likely_binding when an informing family dissents by at least that much. The tier rules themselves are unchanged from v0.1. v0.1.4: cannot_tell_data_gap.E_below lowered from 3 to 2 (option B, decided by Ryan on 26 October 2026 after a five-variant comparison): a node may leave cannot_tell with two independent class A/B voting families. The extreme tiers are unchanged (E_min 5, C_min 3). v0.1.4b: probably_not.N_alt_max = -1.0 mirrors candidate.N_alt_min = 1.0, so a node can be cleared on one strong test as it can be flagged on one; ruled_out unchanged.

ranking._comment: v0.1.2: the bootstrap never resamples a node below E_below voting families (nodes with at most E_below voting families are not resampled and are listed in ranking.not_resampled).

comparators._comment: v0.1.2: the landlocked feature enters the structural distance as a fixed penalty (landlocked_mismatch_penalty squared-distance units, i.e. z = 1) instead of being standardized by its 0.41 sd; candidates whose income observation is more than max_income_age_years older than the universe's latest are excluded; economies on the fragile and conflict-affected list (registry/static_fcs.json) are excluded unless the target is on it.

top_split._comment: v0.1.2: credit growth reads as 'high' only when private credit to GDP is not thin (ICR t of FS.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS > credit_depth_thin_t, the ICR strong threshold); net cash flow from banks is recorded alongside. The cap-at-candidate for finance nodes applies to every row in which the real rate is classified 'low', not only low_demand.

growth_problem._comment: v0.3.0 (rubric 0.3.0, 9 November 2026): a slowdown compares the last decade with the decade before (two windows that do not overlap; 0.2.9 compared the 10- and 20-year averages, so its 1.5-point gap needed a 3-point fall), and a collapse is tried before a slowdown, and five patterns are added for the records that fitted none: acceleration (growth sped up by 2 points or more), never_recovered, high_income_pace, stuck and steady, with not_classifiable where there is no 10-year average. G4 is the growth record in eras since 1990 (least-squares breaks, each era at least 8 years and 2 points from the one before), replacing the single break across the whole series; G3 gains the first year income reached roughly today's level. v0.1.2: the G1 and G5 windows end at the latest year with any growth observation in the universe (window_anchor = latest_observed_year). v0.1.1: collapse_max_peak_age_years, collapse_min_shortfall_pct and the growing rule (growing_*).

settings._comment: Rubric 0.1.8 (front-door PRD W4, docs/calibration-review.md sections 4.4 and 4.5): three named readings of the same evidence. Each setting overrides params.tiers; standard overrides nothing and is the release, the default and the only citable reading. The asymmetry is enforced by the engine (aggregate.mjs paramsForSetting): no setting may loosen the bars for probably_not or ruled_out, or let a node leave cannot_tell with fewer voting families, below standard. None of the three is calibrated until the retrospective (W6) reports.

candour._comment: v0.1.5: economies whose WGI voice and accountability estimate (latest in window) is at or below va_est_max are 'low voice'; indicators flagged regime_sensitive 'low_voice' (firm self-reports of bribery) are class C there. -1.0 is roughly the bottom fifth of economies. A judgment threshold for Phase 0 review.
